title: Kissed Smoky Mexican Pork Carnitas
description: Salty, crisp, and smoky Mexican dish featuring pork carnitas, bottarga, and poblano peppers, perfect for meal prep. This shojin-friendly recipe combines the flavors of Mexico with a hint of smoke and heat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and bottarga, and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the pork for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded.
Remove the pork from the oven and shred with two forks.
Add the roasted poblano peppers and lime juice, and stir to combine.
Increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Return the pork to the oven and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until crispy and caramelized.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
